explanation: Full row rank makes the range of dY.mulVecLin the whole space (Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq), so rank([X|E] dY) = rank [X|E] (mulVecLin_mul, LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top). The column space of [X|E] is range X + range E; by Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq its dimension is rank X + rank E - dim(range X meet range E). With rank E <= m, equality with rank X + m holds iff rank E = m and the intersection has dimension 0, i.e. is trivial (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero, disjoint_iff); omega closes.
